dwarfRunes.name: Dwarf Minor Runes
dwarfRunes.note: Runesmith (Dwarf Rangers); the leader is a younger Runesmith who knows one of these minor runes. Before each game he may inscribe one known rune on an item carried by a warband member (two items with an Apprentice): roll 2D6 — on the rune's difficulty or more the item gains the bonus FOR THAT GAME, any other failure gives no bonus. A roll of 2 is a fumble: the item is destroyed and removed from the warrior's list (it may be replaced before the game if the warband has the gold). New runes may be learned instead of skills on advances. The Jealousy of Runes: bonuses from runes are not cumulative with magical bonuses from other items — a Rune of Stone on a shield and another on armour do not add up to +2, nor does a rune combine with magic armour that adds +1 to the Armour Save.
spells: Rune of Stone (8)
+1 to Armour Save.
Rune of Sharpness (6)
−1 Armour Save modifier to the weapon.
Rune of Speed (7)
Initiative doubled on the weapon.
Rune of Warding (8)
Special 4+ save vs. spells affecting the target (placed on belt, armband, etc.). Cost to replace: 1 gc.
Rune of Accuracy (9)
+1 to hit with the weapon.
Rune of Striding (8)
+1 Movement (placed on boots, belt, etc.). Cost to replace: 1 gc.

woodlandIncantations.name: Woodland Incantations
woodlandIncantations.note: Forest Mage of the Wood Elves of Athel Loren.
spells: Song of Thorns (8)
Branches strike out to the foe under influence of the singer cadence. If no plants are present wooden chips fly at the victim, as if they want to be thorns… Victim suffers 2D6 S1 hits, range 8".
Murmuring of the Wind (7)
Very softly the wind increases around the caster and takes him wherever he wants. Caster may move anywhere within 12", if he gets into HtH it counts as a charge.
The Rain Song (9)

The air around the caster becomes moist and it starts to rain, until it looks like a major downpour… Everything, except Woodelves, within 6" of the caster suffers −1 to hit and suffers −1 Initiative. This lasts until the beginning of the caster's next magic phase.
Lyrics of Feral Infatuation (8)

This soothing song seems to calm even the most ferocious monsters and sends them into a lethargic state. Any animal or monster has to pass a Ld-test, on his own Ld, in order to attack an opponent. If it fails it will do nothing else that turn, not even fighting back if attacked.
Song of the Sun (6)

While the caster sings his victim believes he is in a scorching desert. His movement slows and throat becomes parched. The target must be within 18" and is −1M until the caster's next magic phase, he also must make a test, if he fails, he suffers a S4 hit.
Eagle's Cry (8)

The caster utters a melodious cry, which sounds like a great eagle. This inspires the elves so much they gain the legendary sight of Thuarindir. All Wood elves within 6" gain +1 to hit and +1 on the critical hit table. This lasts until the beginning of the caster's next magic phase.

chaosRituals.name: Chaos Rituals
chaosRituals.note: Magister of the Cult of the Possessed; also used by Daemons, Beastmen and a Marauders of Chaos Seer with the Mark of Chaos Undivided.
spells: Vision of Torment (10)

This spell has a range of 6" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. If the Chaos Mage is in hand-to-hand combat, he must choose his target from those in base contact with him. The affected model is immediately stunned. If the model cannot be stunned it is knocked down instead.
Eye of God (7)

You may use the Eye of God successfully only once per battle. Choose any single model within 6", friend or foe. Roll a D6 to see what happens to the affected model. D6: 1 = The wrath of the gods descends upon the target. The model is taken out of action immediately. He does not have to roll on the Serious Injury chart after the battle though; 2-5 = The model gains +1 to any one of his characteristics during this battle (chosen by the player who cast the spell); 6 = The model gains +1 to all of its characteristics for the duration of the battle.
Dark Blood (8)

This attack has a range of 8" and causes D3 S5 hits. It hits the first model in its path. After using this spell the Chaos Mage must roll on the Injury table for himself to see how dangerous the wound is, though treat the out of action result as stunned instead.
Lure of Chaos (9)

The spell has a range of 12" and must be cast on the closest enemy model. Roll a D6 and add the Chaos Mage's Leadership to the score. Then roll a D6 and add the target's Leadership to the score. If the Chaos Mage beats his opponent's score he gains control of the model until the model passes a Leadership test in his own recovery phase. The model may not commit suicide, but can attack models on his own side, and will not fight warriors from the Chaos Mage's warband. If he was engaged in hand-to-hand combat with any warriors of the Chaos Mage's warband, they will immediately move 1" apart. FAQ: Neither the caster nor the target may use a Leader's Leadership for this contest. The controlled model acts in the controlling player's own turn, so it can shoot at once if it has a missile weapon. The spell has no set end: the Magister may cast it again (also on other models) and control several models at once.
Wings of Darkness (7)

The Chaos Mage may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, in which case he counts as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy, in the close combat phase he will score one automatic hit and then his opponent will flee again (if he survives).
Word of Pain (7)
All models within 3" of the Chaos Mage, friend or foe, suffer one S3 hit. No armour saves are allowed. FAQ: Spells that cause direct damage, such as this one, never cause critical hits.

lore.Vision of Torment: The Chaos Mage summons horrible visions of the realm of Chaos, causing his enemy to recoil in utter horror.
lore.Eye of God: The Chaos Mage implores the Dark gods to grant a boon to their servant.
lore.Dark Blood: The Chaos Mage cuts his palm and his blood spurts out, burning flesh and armour.
lore.Lure of Chaos: The Chaos Mage calls upon the taint of chaos which exists in the inner soul of all living beings.
lore.Wings of Darkness: The Chaos Mage is lifted from the ground by two shadowy Daemons and carried wherever he wants to go.
lore.Word of Pain: Speaking the forbidden name of his dark god, the Chaos Mage causes indescribable pain to all who hear it.

marauderChaos.name: Chaos Magic (Marauders)
marauderChaos.note: The Seer chooses a Mark when hired; the Mark determines his magic. All options below. (Bloodfather = not a wizard.)
spells: ▸ Mark of Tchar the Eagle — Tchar Rituals
The Seer starts with 2 spells (1 chosen freely, 1 random).
Tchar's Blessing (auto)
This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. The Seer may not cast spells in the following battle. After the game he gains D3 Experience points if he wasn't taken out of action.
Dispel Magic (7)
The Seer ends all effects of currently active spells.
Foresight (10)

This spell must be used before the game and may only be used once. Choose a warband. One randomly determined Hero of that warband must miss the following game. Models that are capable of casting spells or prayers are immune to this effect.
Wrath of the Great Eagle (9)

Choose one enemy model within 12". The model is hit with a Strength equal to the difference of the Seer's Experience points and the model's Experience (to a maximum of 10). Armour saves are taken as normal. If the victim has more Experience points than the Seer, the latter is hit instead.
Tchar's Reward (8)

The Seer gets +1 on any one stat per 10 Experience points he has. Each stat may be increased only once through this spell. The power of Tchar's Reward lasts until the end of the Seer's next shooting phase and can be re-cast in that phase. FAQ: When the temporary Wound is lost after the Seer has been wounded, he must roll on the Injury chart (unless the spell is cast again): ending the spell counts as losing his last Wound. Increasing Wounds with this spell is generally a bad idea.
Slave to Chaos (9)

This spell has a range of 12" and causes one Strength 2 hit with no armour save. If the model is taken out of action roll for Serious Injuries immediately. If they die replace the killed warrior with a Horror of Tzeentch (see Bestiary for rules) until the end of the game. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Horror disappears into the Realm of Chaos.
▸ Mark of Shornaal the Serpent — Shornaal Rituals
Pleasure-magic of the Dark Prince.
Delicious Suffering (8)
All models (friend and foe, except for the Seer) within 3" must pass a Ld test or are knocked down.
Dance of the Serpent (8)
All enemy models that are not immune to psychology suffer a −1 'to hit' against him in close combat. The Dance lasts until the beginning of the Seer's next shooting phase.
Endless Torment (9)

Choose one enemy model within 8". From now on the model must roll for injury −1 after its Recovery phase. For the duration of the Torment the Seer can do nothing else but end the spell at the beginning of his turn and if attacked in close combat, he is hit automatically and the spell breaks.
Mystify (8)

Target enemy model within 8" will have their Initiative value reduced to 1 and will always strike last in close combat, even if they charge an opponent or are armed with a spear or pike and are charged themselves. This spell lasts until the target passes a Ld test during the recovery phase.
A Thousand Voices (8)

Choose one enemy model within 12". For the duration of the spell the model reduces its Ld by D3 +1 (to a minimum of 2) if it is not immune to psychology. The model must pass a Ld test at the beginning of its turn to end the spell. The spell breaks also when the Seer loses a wound. A Thousand Voices can only enchant one model at a time.
Shornaal's Temptation (7)

Choose one enemy model within 8" that is not immune to psychology. The model must pass a Ld test. If the model fails, then the Seer gains control over the model. The player may attempt to regain control at the beginning of his turn by passing a Ld test. Shornaal's Temptation can only enchant one model at a time. If the Seer is hit whether by a missile or in close combat he must pass a Ld test or the spell ends. FAQ: A Necromancer who fails the test comes under the caster's control and any Scarecrow bond is broken at once (the Scarecrow is taken out of action); a Liche is immune to psychology and passes automatically. Chained cases: if Seer 1 controls warrior X and Seer 2 then tempts Seer 1, Seer 1's earlier control ends, Seer 1 comes under Seer 2's control and X returns to its original controller.
▸ Mark of Onogal the Crow — Nurgle Rituals
Uses the Nurgle Rituals (see Carnival), but spell 1 is replaced by Touch of Onogal. The Seer is immune to poison.
Touch of Onogal (10)

This spell can be used against one of the Seer's close combat opponents. If he takes the model out of action in the following hand-to-hand combat phase, that player rolls for Serious Injuries immediately. If the model dies permanently, replace it with a Nurgle Plague Bearer (see Bestiary for rules) for the rest of the game under the Seer's control. If the Seer is stunned or taken out of action the Plague Bearer disappears into the Realm of Chaos. Note that only one Plague Bearer can be created at a time.
▸ Mark of Arkhar the Dog — Bloodfather
NOT a wizard! War-priest: Each time he takes an enemy out of action in close combat, take a Ld test → +1 to WS, S, T or I (each only once) until the end of the battle. May also take Strength skills.
▸ Mark of Chaos Undivided — Chaos Rituals
The Seer uses the Chaos Rituals (see Cult of the Possessed).

lore.Foresight: The Changer of the Ways pulls the strings of destiny to protect his servants.

lore.Tchar's Reward: The Seer is rewarded for his great power.

lore.Dance of the Serpent: The Seer’s sight is so incredibly fascinating that his opponents cannot help starring stupidly while he draws his sword.

Buboes (7)

Stench of Nurgle (8)
This spell has a range of 6" and affects all living creatures — friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.
Pestilence (10)
All enemy models within 12" of the Master suffer a Strength 3 hit. No Armour saves are allowed.
Scabrous Hide (8)
